title: Chen's complete-monotonicity remainder conjecture for Bernoulli polynomials
statement:
For $t>0$ and $m\in\mathbb{N}_0$, let $B_n(x)$ denote the Bernoulli polynomials and define

$$
\mu_m(t)=\frac{e^{t/3}-e^{2t/3}}{e^{t}-1}-\sum_{j=0}^{m}\frac{2B_{2j+1}(\frac{1}{3})}{(2j+1)!}t^{2j}.
$$

Also define

$$
\nu_m(t)=\frac{e^{t/4}-e^{3t/4}}{e^{t}-1}-\sum_{j=0}^{m}\frac{2B_{2j+1}(\frac{1}{4})}{(2j+1)!}t^{2j}.
$$

**Chen's conjecture.** For every $t>0$ and $m\in\mathbb{N}_0$, one has

$$
(-1)^m\mu_m(t)>0
$$

and

$$
(-1)^m\nu_m(t)>0.
$$

These are sign conjectures for the remainders in Bernoulli-polynomial expansions of the two exponential quotients. The supplied source does not indicate whether the conjecture has been resolved.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1601.02192

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of January 2016).
source_name: C. -P. Chen and R. B. Paris, “Some results associated with Bernoulli and Euler numbers with applications”, arXiv:1601.02192 (2016).
